title: JD.com launches Joybuy in Europe, targeting Amazon
title_zh: 京东在欧洲推出Joybuy，瞄准亚马逊
summary: The launch comes as Chinese retailers and brands have been expanding abroad in the U.S. and Europe, looking for new growth drivers away ‌from the cut-throat competition and ⁠weak consumer demand they face at home.
summary_zh: 此次推出之际，中国零售商和品牌一直在美国和欧洲进行海外扩张，寻找新的增长动力，以摆脱国内激烈的竞争和疲软的消费者需求。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures climb as oil rises with US and Iran targeting energy infrastructure
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货上涨，因美国和伊朗瞄准能源基础设施而油价上涨
summary: An incredibly unstable energy market has thrown equities into disarray as the Iran war shows no signs of slowing.
summary_zh: 由于伊朗战争没有任何放缓的迹象，能源市场极其不稳定，导致股市陷入混乱。

title: A 'dividend' for your crypto? Wall Street's newest way to sweeten the deal for ETF holders
title_zh: 您的加密货币的“红利”？华尔街为 ETF 持有者提供便利交易的最新方式
summary: Crypto investors are turning to yield-bearing digital asset products.
summary_zh: 加密货币投资者正在转向有收益的数字资产产品。

title: Why surging oil prices should matter even if you own Apple, Nvidia, and Microsoft
title_zh: 为什么即使你拥有苹果、英伟达和微软，油价飙升也应该很重要
summary: Connecting the dots on oil prices will serve you well.
summary_zh: 将石油价格的各个点联系起来将对您很有帮助。

title: A critical Fed meeting, $100 oil, and Micron earnings: What to watch this week
title_zh: 重要的美联储会议、100 美元油价和美光财报：本周值得关注的内容
summary: As the Iran war enters its third week, rising oil prices, Wednesday's Fed meeting, and earnings from Micron will be in focus for investors.
summary_zh: 随着伊朗战争进入第三周，油价上涨、周三的美联储会议以及美光科技的财报将成为投资者关注的焦点。

title: Nvidia GTC 2026: What to expect from Nvidia's biggest event of the year
title_zh: Nvidia GTC 2026：对 Nvidia 年度最大活动有何期待
summary: Nvidia will host its annual GTC event in San Jose, Calif., starting on Monday.
summary_zh: Nvidia 将于周一开始在加利福尼亚州圣何塞举办年度 GTC 活动。

title: Rivian's base R2 starts at $45K but won't be available until late 2027
title_zh: Rivian 的基础版 R2 起价为 4.5 万美元，但要到 2027 年底才会上市
summary: Rivian revealed trim levels and pricing on Thursday for its highly anticipated R2 midsize electric SUV, but the version with Tesla Model Y-killer pricing won't be coming this year.
summary_zh: Rivian 周四公布了其备受期待的 R2 中型电动 SUV 的内饰水平和定价，但具有特斯拉 Model Y 杀手级定价的版本今年不会推出。
